journeys.title: Modules, plans, entity types and existing history
journeys.fixture: Separate company/sole-proprietor/personal/pending entities; explicit module flags and supported plan.

cases.title: Plan versus custom modules
cases.given: Growth default inventory on; explicit inventory false.
cases.action: Load permissions and submit physical write.
cases.expected: Actual persisted false is honored; default plan does not silently re-enable; UI and server both reflect effective capability.

cases.title: Module off with history
cases.given: Posted invoice/stock movement exists.
cases.action: Disable relevant module then view history and attempt new write.
cases.expected: Preserve authorized historical read/report; reject new unsupported write; no deletion/reclassification of issued facts.

cases.title: Viewer allow override
cases.given: Viewer receives allow override on write key.
cases.action: Attempt same write with Owner positive control.
cases.expected: Ceiling still prevents elevation; own Viewer no financial/document writes.

cases.title: Owner explicit deny
cases.given: Owner has write permission explicitly denied.
cases.expected: Effective deny applies per authoritative policy; UI visibility does not overrule server ceiling.

cases.title: HR advertised coming soon
cases.given: Module catalog has hr key but not implemented payroll.
cases.action: Try to include payroll in supported workbook execution.
cases.expected: Record future capability/backlog; no payroll acceptance or fake salary workflow from a module key alone.

cases.action: Navigate back and submit stale A form while B context active.
cases.expected: Deny or explicitly rebind/reconfirm under supported contract; no A data written into B and no stale A cache in B.
